entries.title: Job 34:1
segments: Moreover Elihu answered and said,

entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

entries.title: Job 34:3
segments: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.

entries.title: Job 34:4
segments: Let us choose for us that which is right: Let us know among ourselves what is good.

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: For Job hath said, I am righteous, And God hath taken away my right:

entries.title: Job 34:6
segments: Notwithstanding my right I am [accounted] a liar; My wound is incurable, [though I am] without transgression.

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scoffing like water,

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men?

entries.title: Job 34:9
segments: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.

entries.title: Job 34:10
segments: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

entries.title: Job 34:11
segments: For the work of a man will he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.

entries.title: Job 34:12
segments: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments: Who gave him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments: If he set his heart upon himself, [If] he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

entries.title: Job 34:15
segments: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.

entries.title: Job 34:16
segments: If now [thou hast] understanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Shall even one that hateth justice govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is righteous [and] mighty?-

entries.title: Job 34:18
segments: [Him] that saith to a king, [Thou art] vile, [Or] to nobles, [Ye are] wicked;

entries.title: Job 34:19
segments: That respecteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor; For they all are the work of his hands.

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand.

entries.title: Job 34:21
segments: For his eyes are upon the ways of a man, And he seeth all his goings.

entries.title: Job 34:22
segments: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

entries.title: Job 34:23
segments: For he needeth not further to consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:24
segments: He breaketh in pieces mighty men [in ways] past finding out, And setteth others in their stead.

entries.title: Job 34:25
segments: Therefore he taketh knowledge of their works; And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

entries.title: Job 34:26
segments: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: Because they turned aside from following him, And would not have regard in any of his ways:

entries.title: Job 34:28
segments: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heard the cry of the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 34:29
segments: When he giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Alike whether [it be done] unto a nation, or unto a man:

entries.title: Job 34:30
segments: That the godless man reign not, That there be none to ensnare the people.

entries.title: Job 34:31
segments: For hath any said unto God, I have borne [chastisement], I will not offend [any more]:

entries.title: Job 34:32
segments: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more?

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments: Shall his recompense be as thou wilt, that thou refusest it? For thou must choose, and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.

entries.title: Job 34:34
segments: Men of understanding will say unto me, Yea, every wise man that heareth me:

entries.title: Job 34:35
segments: Job speaketh without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: Would that Job were tried unto the end, Because of his answering like wicked men.

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin; He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.
